name: Bộ Công an residence portal (đăng ký / gia hạn tạm trú)

status.description: Where the portal tab is: no-portal-tab | login-needed (returned as {stop}) | dossier-list (with dossier/procedure/status rows) | form-open (dossier code, fee, declarer, members, attachment rows) | payment | portal.

open.description: Open the procedure entry on the ministry portal (TAMTRU_01 đăng ký tạm trú, TAMTRU_02 gia hạn tạm trú). Logged out, it lands on the VNeID SSO page, which stays with the human.

edit.description: Reopen a saved draft or filed dossier in the form view by its numeric id (from the list page's update_hoso_dvc(<id>,2)).

fill.description: Fill the residence form from a household object: province/ward, declarer auto-fill (chkIS_REPORTER), case code, address, term, phone, email, note, members (name/dob/sex/id/rel), filer roles, liability tick, fee check. No submit.

members.description: [{name, dob, sex: 2|3, id, rel: 04 Vợ | 05 Chồng | 08 Con}]

attach.description: Attachment rows + uploads. Row 0 is the portal's fixed CT01 row; entries without row are created with name. Verified by row text, since the input reads back empty after the AJAX upload.

attachments.description: [{row?: 0, name?: string, type: 1 bản gốc | 2 bản sao | 6 giấy tờ điện tử, files: [absolute paths]}]

draft.description: Lưu nháp after dropping blank member rows; returns the G01 dossier code(s) visible on the page it lands on.

printCt01.description: Click In CT01 with downloads allowed into dir; the portal always writes CT01.pdf.

submit.description: Nộp hồ sơ by a real coordinate click (a synthetic click is popup-blocked and the portal reports a payment-gateway error). Polls for the Vietcombank payment URL, which the human then pays.
